claims.claim: This green ceiling shelters between forty and seventy-five percent of the planet’s known species, and scientists believe millions more remain undiscovered.
claims.quote: Estimates vary from 40% to 75% of all biotic species being indigenous to the rainforests

claims.claim: Because many plants yield medicines, the forest has been called the world’s largest pharmacy, providing over a quarter of natural remedies.
claims.evidence: Rainforests as a source of medicines
claims.quote: Tropical rainforests have been called the 'jewels of the Earth' and the 'world's largest pharmacy', because over one quarter of natural medicines have been discovered there

claims.claim: The Amazon rainforest, spanning over 670 million hectares, is the largest terrestrial carbon sink, playing a crucial role in mitigating global warming by capturing up to 25% of global carbon dioxide emissions.
claims.evidence: Amazon rainforest size and carbon capture
claims.quote: Hutan Amazon memiliki luas 670.000.000 hektar ... dan diperkirakan dapat menangkap hingga 25% dari generasi karbon dioksida global menjadi tanaman dan biomassa lainnya

claims.claim: Yet the same canopy is under siege; slash-and-burn clearing during the dry season sparks fires that surged dramatically in 2019, with satellite data showing more than 80,000 fires across Brazil, a 77% rise, darkening skies as far away as São Paulo.
claims.quote: As of August 29, 2019, INPE reported more than 80,000 fires across all of Brazil, a 77% year-to-year increase for the same tracking period

claims.claim: The canopy’s health therefore matters to the whole planet, acting as a buffer against global warming, and protecting it preserves countless species, medicines, and the climate we all share.
claims.evidence: Importance of rainforests for the planet
claims.quote: The largest terrestrial carbon dioxide sink and plays a significant role in mitigating global warming
